## Read Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data <- read_csv("aggregated-w3-sleep.csv")
```

## Density Plots

```{r}
data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = c3tstall)) +
    geom_density(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(
      title = "Probability Density Plot of Stall Time",
      x = "Stall Time (c3tstall)",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = c3sleff)) +
    geom_density(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(
      title = "Probability Density Plot of Sleep Efficiency",
      x = "Stall Time (c3tstall)",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
data |>
  ggplot(aes(sample = c3tstall)) +
  stat_qq(color = "steelblue") +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Q-Q Plot of Stall Time",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
data |>
  ggplot(aes(sample = c3sleff)) +
  stat_qq(color = "steelblue") +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Q-Q Plot of Stall Time",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(broom)
library(gt)  # or use kableExtra

# Run the test
shapiro.test(na.omit(data$c3tstall))
shapiro.test(na.omit(data$c3sleff))
```

## Correlation and Scatter Plots

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = c3tstall, y = c3sleff)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x = 300, label.y = 90) +  # Customize label position
  labs(
    title = "Scatter Plot with Correlation Coefficient",
    x = "Stall Time (c3tstall)",
    y = "Sleep Efficiency (c3sleff)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
